title: 第二十四章元婴？
novel_title: 扫地八十年，从宗门杂役飞升成仙
content_zh:
说书人捋了捋胡子，满意地点头。

    “那场雷劫，渡劫的不是别人。”

    “正是咱安家的老太爷，安平顺！”

    “如今老太爷已经熬过了天劫，结成了元婴！”

    “轰”的一声，满堂哗然。

    叶凡端着茶碗的手，停在了半空。

    元婴?

    他差点没把茶喷出来。

    叶凡虽然修为浅，可活了九十年，在宗门待了一辈子，这点见识还是有的。

    元婴是什么概念?

    那是修仙路上一道天堑。多少人卡在金丹一辈子，连元婴的门槛都摸不着。要结元婴，顶级的天赋、海量的资源、上乘的功法，缺一不可。

    最要命的还是那场天劫。十个渡劫的，能活下来一两个就算祖坟冒青烟了。

    天剑宗那么大个宗门，元婴老祖统共也没几个，平日里都在闭关，轻易见不着面。

    而这安平城底下,居然藏着一位刚结元婴的老怪物?

    叶凡咂了咂嘴。

    怪不得。

    怪不得这城繁华成这样，怪不得守城兵卒见了天剑宗令牌都客气。

    合着这城里头，蹲着一尊比天剑宗大多数老祖都不差的大佬。

    可叶凡转念又觉得不对。

    就算是元婴，能凭一己之力，把一个几千人的破镇子，撑成数十万人口的大城?

    元婴是厉害，可元婴又不是神仙。他一个人再能打，也变不出粮食，变不出绸缎，变不出这满街的车马人流。

    这里头，肯定还有别的门道。

    叶凡皱着眉头，慢慢嚼着嘴里的肉。

    说书人那头还在继续吹。

    什么安老太爷年轻时如何如何，什么安家几代人如何如何，越说越玄乎，到后头都快把安平顺说成下凡的星君了。

    叶凡听了个大概，也没全信。

    说书人嘛，三分真七分编，图的是听众那几个赏钱。

    但有一点能确定。

    安家，是这城里头真正的主子。安平顺这位元婴老祖，就是这城的天。

    叶凡低头扒了口饭。

    他来这城，本是为了淘换废旧法器。现在看来，这地方比他想的水深得多。

    修士遍地，家族势力盘踞，头顶还压着个元婴。

    行事得更小心些。

    他可不想还没搞清楚状况，就一头撞进哪个大人物的局里。

    正琢磨着，肚子里的饭菜下去大半，整个人也缓过来不少。

    叶凡刚要招呼小二再添碗饭，眼角余光瞥见有人朝他这桌走来。

    那人是个公子打扮。

    锦缎长袍，腰间挂着块成色不错的玉佩，头发梳得整整齐齐，二十出头的模样，脸上带着笑。

    他走到叶凡桌前，拱了拱手。

    “这位兄台，实在不好意思。”

    “今儿楼里人多，实在没空位了。看您这桌还宽敞，能否拼个座?”

    叶凡抬头看了他一眼。

    大堂里确实坐满了，过道上都有人站着等位。

    这公子哥说话客气，脸上也没什么恶意，不像是来找茬的。

    叶凡点了点头，往旁边挪了挪。
content_en:
The storyteller stroked his beard and nodded with satisfaction.

    "In that thunder tribulation, it was no one else who survived the tribulation."

    "It's our An family's old man, An Pingshun!"

    "Now the old man has survived the catastrophe and formed the Nascent Soul!"

    There was a "boom" and the whole hall was in an uproar.

    Ye Fan's hand holding the tea bowl stopped in mid-air.

    Nascent Soul?

    He almost spit out his tea.

    Although Ye Fan has a low level of cultivation, he has lived for ninety years and has been in the sect all his life, so he still has this knowledge.

    What is the concept of Nascent Soul?

    That is a natural chasm on the road to immortality. How many people have been stuck in the golden elixir all their lives, unable to even touch the threshold of Nascent Soul. To form a Nascent Soul, top talents, massive resources, and superior techniques are all indispensable.

    The most terrible thing was the disaster. Of the ten people who have overcome the tribulation, if one or two survive, it will be regarded as smoke rising from their ancestral graves.

    For a sect as big as Tianjian Sect, there are only a few ancestors of Yuanying. They are in seclusion on weekdays and rarely see each other.

    And underneath Anping City, there is actually an old monster who has just become a Nascent Soul?

    Ye Fan smacked his lips.

    No wonder.

    No wonder the city is so prosperous, no wonder the soldiers guarding the city were polite when they saw the Tianjian Sect token.

    In the middle of this city, squatting is a big boss who is as good as most of the ancestors of Tianjian Sect.

    But Ye Fan changed his mind and felt something was wrong.

    Even Nascent Soul can single-handedly turn a run-down town of a few thousand people into a large city with a population of hundreds of thousands?

    Yuanying is powerful, but Yuanying is not a god. No matter how hard he fights alone, he can't produce food, silk, or the traffic of cars, horses, and people in the streets.

    There must be other ways here.

    Ye Fan frowned and slowly chewed the meat in his mouth.

    The storyteller continued to blow.

    What Mr. An was like when he was young, and what generations of An family were like, became more and more mysterious as they talked about it. In the end, An Pingshun was almost said to be a star king who descended to earth.

    Ye Fan heard the general idea but didn't believe it all.

    As a storyteller, 30% of the truth is 70% of editing, and the purpose is to get some rewards from the audience.

    But one thing is certain.

    An Jia is the real master of this city. An Pingshun, the ancestor of Yuanying, is the sky of this city.

    Ye Fan lowered his head and took a bite of rice.

    He came to this city originally to buy and exchange used magic weapons. Now it seems that this place is much deeper than he thought.

    There are monks all over the place, the family power is entrenched, and there is a Nascent Soul weighing above his head.

    Act more carefully.

    He didn't want to fall into the trap of some big shot before he understood the situation.

    Just as I was thinking about it, most of the food in my stomach was gone, and I felt relieved a lot.

    Just as Ye Fan was about to ask the waiter to add another bowl of rice, he saw someone walking towards his table out of the corner of his eye.

    That man was dressed like a young man.

    Wearing a brocade robe, a jade pendant of good quality hung around his waist, his hair neatly combed, he looked to be in his early twenties, with a smile on his face.

    He walked to Ye Fan's desk and cupped his hands.

    "Brother, I'm really sorry."

    "There are a lot of people in the building today, so there is really no space left. Seeing that your table is quite spacious, can we share a seat?"

    Mark Ye raised his head and glanced at him.

    The lobby was indeed full, and there were people standing in the aisles waiting for tables.

    The young man spoke politely and showed no malice on his face. He didn't look like he was looking for trouble.

    Ye Fan nodded and moved to the side.
